title: Wordfeud

finder.blankHint: Use * for blank tiles (0 points). Max 7 letters.
finder.patternHint: Enter your rack tiles above and the pattern below. Results use both sets of letters.
finder.hint: Enter your tiles and search to find playable words.

board.title: Board Editor
board.hint: Click a cell and type to place a letter. Arrow keys to navigate, Tab to switch entry direction, Backspace to clear or step back, Space to toggle blank, Escape to exit the grid.
board.excludeHint: Click a tile to leave it out of the suggestions.
board.opponentRackHint: Bag has ≤7 tiles — these tiles must be in your opponent's rack.

selectGameHint: Select a game from the list to view the board.
notConnected: No Wordfeud account connected. Connect your account in Settings to load your games.
notConnectedNonAdmin: No Wordfeud account connected. Ask an admin to connect a Wordfeud account in Settings.

solver.blockHint: Ranking moves that leave your opponent their weakest reply, based on their known tiles.
solver.blockDisabledHint: Available only when the bag is empty and the opponent's tiles are known.

localGames.title: Local Games
localGames.noGames: No local games yet. Create one to start tracking scores.

league.seasonOver: Season is over — waiting for the next group
league.stale: The league site can't be reached. Showing the table from {{date}}.
league.wordfeudNotConnected: No Wordfeud account connected, so games and invites are not shown.
league.acceptInApp: Accept the invitation in the Wordfeud app.
league.reportIntro: Register this result against {{opponent}} on the league site. Check the scores first.
league.resignedOpponent: Your opponent resigned. The scores follow the league rule: 150–0, or their score minus 50, whichever gives you the bigger margin.
league.resignedMe: You resigned. The scores follow the league rule: 0–150, or your score minus 50, whichever gives your opponent the bigger margin.
league.needEmail: Posting results needs the email address you use on the league site.

setup.title: Wordfeud League of Honour
setup.intro: Show your league group here, invite opponents and post results. Use the same username as on wordfeud.aasmul.net.
setup.emailHint: Only needed to post results. The league site logs in with username and email, no password.
setup.emailHintEdit: Leave empty to keep the stored email.

errors.player_not_found: No current league group found for that username
errors.league_login_failed: The league site did not accept that username and email
errors.league_unavailable: The league site can't be reached right now
errors.invite_unsupported: Invites aren't supported for this league
errors.already_started: There is already a game or invitation with this opponent
errors.already_reported: This match already has a result
errors.not_registered: The league site did not register the result
